html:
SMTO-LLM-0047 — The model sent several answers at once

GUID: 2bb1776a-cd40-4788-bd60-2f55a6eb4433
Slug: model-choice-ambiguous
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: llm

What happened

  • SMTO needs exactly one answer from the model to decide what to do next. This reply had several answers, or none in a usable shape, so SMTO didn't act on it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait to see whether the Run continues. SMTO may ask the model once more by itself after a reply it can't use. The model may send a single answer on its next try.
  2. If the Run stopped, read its activity in the conversation to see which steps already finished, then ask the Agent to continue only the rest. SMTO did not act on that reply, but steps before it already happened. Repeating them could do the same work twice.
  3. If it keeps happening, ask the person who runs the model server to make it return one answer per request, or choose a different model in Settings › Setup › Model routing. Several answers usually come from a server or request setting that asks for multiple replies.

What success looks like

  • The Run continues past this step, and the Agent's next action appears in its activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model server or manages SMTO. Don't ask the Agent to redo steps that already finished.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The response's choices field is not a list of exactly one object, so no single semantic decision can be selected.

What this means

  • Decision processing accepts one semantic choice; multiple choices or a non-object choice cannot be safely combined into a single instruction. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Decision processing accepts one semantic choice; multiple choices or a non-object choice cannot be safely combined into a single instruction.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the provider's choice count and choice object shape; ensure streaming fragments all belong to the supported single choice.

How to fix it

  • Raised by normalize_response in src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/response.py and validate_envelope in native_protocol.py. SMTO requests a single completion (n is not an allowed request override), so inspect the raw response in the trace and fix the provider or any proxy in front of it that returns several choices or a non-object choice; do not merge choices.
  • Configure the endpoint to return exactly one semantic choice for the supported API; do not merge competing choices.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Exactly one supported choice survives normalization and envelope validation.

What not to do

  • Do not replay prior successful operations to repair a later model response.
  • Do not disable protocol validation or treat this representation failure as input-context overflow.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
